description: Resolve DNS records for a domain via the system resolver. Default lookup covers A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA. Also resolves reverse PTR records for A results. Use this to debug mail config (MX), domain ownership signals (TXT), name-server delegation (NS), CAA policy, and IP resolution. No SSRF risk — DNS only, no outbound connections.
name: dns_lookup
